_comment: Phase 85 Plan 07 — CONFIRMED Phorest v3 AppointmentResponse subset (source: ref/phorest-openapi-v3.json, schema AppointmentResponse under DataPagedModelAppointmentResponse). Two mapped-staff slots (09:00-10:30, 11:00-11:45). The date lives in the SEPARATE appointmentDate field ('yyyy-MM-dd'); startTime/endTime are Joda LocalTime 'HH:mm:ss' (NOT ISO datetimes). Each item DELIBERATELY carries the real PII fields the live payload also carries (clientId/clientName/serviceName/price/notes) so the SA-02 DSGVO drop test bites: the closed mapAppointment() must keep every one of them out of the stored row. The test rewrites appointmentDate onto an in-window date.
